preconditions.description: The number of vertices in each part and the number of edges are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n1 and 1 <= vi <= n2 for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within their respective parts.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the total number of vertices in both parts.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith(str(k)) for k, line in enumerate(output_lines, start=1))
postconditions.description: Each line starts with the value of k.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(edge_index) <= m for edge_index in line.split()[1:]) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: All edge indices in the output lines are within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split()[1:])) == len(line.split()[1:]) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: All edge indices in the output lines are unique.
